blocks.content: Explore a dashboard and identify which of its panels are USE measurements and which are RED measurements, naming the measurement each one shows.
Open **Sample Website Dashboard** in full-dashboard view.
Find **Memory / CPU** and the **Memory** gauge. These measure a machine's resources, so they belong to the USE method. Both show how much of the resource is in use, which is utilization.

Find **server requests** and **client side full page load**. These measure the service as its users experience it, so they belong to the RED method. Requests over time is the rate. Page load time is the duration.
RED has a third measurement, errors. Look for a panel that counts failing requests. There isn't one, so this dashboard can't tell you whether requests are failing.
The four golden signals name the same three service measurements as RED, as traffic, errors, and latency, and add saturation: how close a resource is to its capacity. No panel here shows that either.

The remaining panels, **logins**, **Google hits**, **Support calls**, and **Sign ups**, are business measurements. Neither method covers them. The methods tell you what a health dashboard needs, not what every dashboard must contain.
You've identified a dashboard's resource and service measurements and spotted what's missing. The question a dashboard answers tells you which method it needs.
